1603421426169663488.a: I have read and heard a lot of stories My observation about society today, and likely in the past moreso, that people confuse the difference between an idea and reality.

1603421427557978112.a: You can look at Mayan and Egyptian tech and find many similarities. It's easy to see how the Mayans developed this tech themselves. It is obviously not Egyptian but the math and geometry is similar for many reasons.

1603421428988235778.a: It is also easy to see there are shared memories and stories feeding into some of that. Serpents, pyramids, etc. It is easy to confuse those threads of knowledge (science, math, etc) for the work required to implement them in a way that builds a pyramid or serpent mound.

1603421430246522884.a: Carrying the ancient knowledge of math, science, astronomy, calendars, founding myths, etc with you as your people evolve and migrate from one place to another over millenia is also very easy to confuse for some magic creatures doing the work.

1603421431555145728.a: Sometimes a boat did arrive at a primitive shore and more advanced people traded with those people. That kind story is easy to run away with and hallucinate some vast conspiracy of global civilization. Idiots will point to that one incident as evidence all such stories are real.

1603422406692970502.a: My childhood was filled with stories of ancient times. What I learned as a Rosicrucian student is reality and truth is more important than stories. Outsiders look at our stories and assume they are real. They are merely a prompt to explore reality with science and reason. 🙏🌞

1603422878183329792.a: We RC are here to preserve the stories and find the truth within them. Not to bend the truth to fit the story. I encourage all esoteric traditions to adopt this one critical perspective. We do remember things you forgot but we are not so arrogant as to believe memories are real.

1603424149665218560.a: There is a taboo against telling people your dreams but many have conveyed similar dreams as I after a RC initiation; so I feel the world is meant to hear it.
